metadata.title: Scaling Foundation Model Systems: Hardware, Networking, and Resilience
metadata.reference_summary: The 2026 AI Systems keynote addresses infrastructure challenges for training trillion-parameter foundation models across 32,000 accelerators. Key solutions include 3D parallelism (Tensor, Pipeline, and ZeRO Data Parallelism), non-blocking asynchronous checkpointing to combat low MTBF, and PagedAttention with speculative decoding for inference. Algorithmic innovations like state-space models and FP8 quantization improve efficiency while achieving 64% sustained Model FLOPs Utilization.
